costs.rounding: Decimal to yuan cents at fee boundary; retain underlying raw precision
costs.unknown_policy: Unknown actual fee never becomes0; use explicit scenario intervals in research and retain formal cost-input restriction.

design.event: Positive RAW realized20-session round-trip net return under frozen execution and known company-action treatment; unresolved action/status yields unscorable/interval cases, never zero

execution.coverage: Only actually archived checkpoints; later price supplementation cannot backfill an unarchived forecast
execution.maturity: After20 trading sessions or preregistered deterministic terminal settlement; unconfirmed settlement unresolved. At deadline unmatured labels separately listed, never scored/learned.
execution.missing_or_unknown: No imputation/no selective deletion: explicit inability-to-trade/unknown-status intervals and missing rows, report sensitivity; uncertain action treatment or label cannot be scored
execution.partial_or_missed: 0/50/100% execution stress, retain all rejected opportunities; no fill does not label prediction loss
execution.price_window: Use next declared daily OHLC and explicit exchange rule limit; orders outside frozen permissible price band do not fill
execution.quantity: 100-share ordinary SSE MAIN lot, Decimal cash/fees and T+1 available shares; no leverage
execution.synthetic_basis: Research simulation scale chosen to allow at least one100-share600519 lot under50% exposure at publicly reported1258.62 quote; not user funds/baseline/authorization or research runtime money budget

checkpoints.operations: Every actual running post-market checkpoint; missing days retained
checkpoints.statistics: At registered30-session mature-results review and qualification expiry; no extra confirmation PASS look

formal_monitoring.drift: Fit feature1st/99th percentiles on DEVELOPMENT only; if >=20% of latest20 eligible observations outside fixed reference or required-input coverage<80%, restrict use pending review. Operational sentinel, not a causal or statistical profitability verdict.
formal_monitoring.execution: Compare actual next-open/next-close delays, missing/partial fills, quote-vs-fill, realized fees with frozen scenarios; outside declared delay/price/cost bounds immediately restrict affected ability without declaring statistical FAIL
formal_monitoring.mature_results: Report fixed mature probability/utility/support checks at registered review; insufficient evidence=>INCONCLUSIVE, no adjusting cutoffs on new losses
formal_monitoring.policy_change: Reason+new fingerprint+successor protocol, preserve previous verdict and visits; no silent threshold changes

parameter_neighborhood.evaluation: One-at-a-time neighbors around fixed primary, never choose a neighbor winner; each fit/candidate/threshold attempt persisted

g5.required: Base improvement>=25bp NAV with preregistered interval/risk/support; stressed net value must not reverse below comparable baseline, risk bounds hold. Insufficient stress support is INCONCLUSIVE; failure cannot be repaired by shrinking old scope.
g5.time_segments: Report each chronological third of the eligible historical test and forward mature window, same targets; each insufficient segment remains INCONCLUSIVE
g5.unknown_scope: Other names/boards/markets are monitoring only; extension needs linked new experiment and unused evidence

design.hypothesis: A fixed transparent daily price-volume candidate improves fee-after return under matched risk/exposure; not best retrospective stock selection

label_isolation.rule: A fitted label must mature inside its allowed DEVELOPMENT/CALIBRATION window; boundary-spanning labels purged. Calibration receives preceding20 rows only as past feature context; no random same-day split.

primary_objective.basis: Research choice before outcome computation. Assumed3bp commission each side +5bp sell stamp +0.1bp transfer each side +5bp slippage each side =21.2bp trade cost; at50% exposure10.6bp NAV. Twice this rounded upward to25bp is a meaningful NAV improvement hurdle, not estimated alpha or actual broker cost.
primary_objective.confidence_rule: One-sided95% lower bound >0.0025 at single final point; all required comparisons/gates must hold
primary_objective.metric: Paired20-session fee-after NAV return improvement over every preregistered comparable baseline

statistics.method: Paired calendar-date moving-block bootstrap, block length20 sessions; same-day securities jointly resampled; seed1701,2000 replicates
statistics.multiple_comparison_policy: Intersection-union: every preregistered required baseline and gate must pass; no choosing favorable comparison. Sensitivity does not create another PASS look.
probability_checks: Brier/log loss against development base rate and transparent rule
fixed5 equal-width reliability bins,20 mature cases per occupied bin
ROC discrimination and selected-subset support, no probability reliability claim from lower Brier alone
statistics.reference: Kunsch(1989), The jackknife and the bootstrap for general stationary observations, Ann.Statist.17:1217–1241; author bibliography https://people.math.ethz.ch/~hkuensch/papers/
statistics.validity: Stationarity/weak-dependence assumptions and finite-sample coverage must be automatically validated and technically reviewed in20.30 blocks is a conservative design eligibility condition, not a universal bootstrap theorem; inadequate support or failed assumptions=>INCONCLUSIVE, never lower cutoff after seeing sealed.

stopping.calendar_month_rule: Local wall time; month addition clamps to destination month end; inclusive final cutoff, no90-day substitution
early_stops: user stops ability; statistical verdict separately preserved
stopping.forward_origin: First successfully persisted actual frozen-model future prediction in30/32; protocol registration/deployment/historical replay/synthetic account do not start it
stopping.no_extension: Absence/backend switching/unfavorable results/maturity deficits never extend original deadline; successor requires new information value

support_projection.historical_final_independence: UNPROVEN; engineering archive exposure is recorded, no strategy results examined

execution.coverage: Only actually archived checkpoints; later price supplementation cannot backfill an unarchived forecast
execution.maturity: After20 trading sessions or preregistered deterministic terminal settlement; unconfirmed settlement unresolved. At deadline unmatured labels separately listed, never scored/learned.

execution.partial_or_missed: 0/50/100% execution stress, retain all rejected opportunities; no fill does not label prediction loss
execution.price_window: Use next declared daily OHLC and explicit exchange rule limit; orders outside frozen permissible price band do not fill
execution.quantity: 100-share ordinary SSE MAIN lot, Decimal cash/fees and T+1 available shares; no leverage
execution.synthetic_basis: Research simulation scale chosen to allow at least one100-share600519 lot under50% exposure at publicly reported1258.62 quote; not user funds/baseline/authorization or research runtime money budget

checkpoints.operations: Every actual running post-market checkpoint; missing days retained
checkpoints.statistics: At registered30-session mature-results review and qualification expiry; no extra confirmation PASS look

formal_monitoring.drift: Fit feature1st/99th percentiles on DEVELOPMENT only; if >=20% of latest20 eligible observations outside fixed reference or required-input coverage<80%, restrict use pending review. Operational sentinel, not a causal or statistical profitability verdict.
formal_monitoring.execution: Compare actual next-open/next-close delays, missing/partial fills, quote-vs-fill, realized fees with frozen scenarios; outside declared delay/price/cost bounds immediately restrict affected ability without declaring statistical FAIL
formal_monitoring.mature_results: Report fixed mature probability/utility/support checks at registered review; insufficient evidence=>INCONCLUSIVE, no adjusting cutoffs on new losses
formal_monitoring.policy_change: Reason+new fingerprint+successor protocol, preserve previous verdict and visits; no silent threshold changes

parameter_neighborhood.evaluation: One-at-a-time neighbors around fixed primary, never choose a neighbor winner; each fit/candidate/threshold attempt persisted

g5.required: Base improvement>=25bp NAV with preregistered interval/risk/support; stressed net value must not reverse below comparable baseline, risk bounds hold. Insufficient stress support is INCONCLUSIVE; failure cannot be repaired by shrinking old scope.
g5.time_segments: Report each chronological third of the eligible historical test and forward mature window, same targets; each insufficient segment remains INCONCLUSIVE
g5.unknown_scope: Other names/boards/markets are monitoring only; extension needs linked new experiment and unused evidence

design.hypothesis: A fixed transparent daily price-volume candidate improves fee-after return under matched risk/exposure; not best retrospective stock selection

label_isolation.rule: A fitted label must mature inside its allowed DEVELOPMENT/CALIBRATION window; boundary-spanning labels purged. Calibration receives preceding20 rows only as past feature context; no random same-day split.

primary_objective.basis: Research choice before outcome computation. Assumed3bp commission each side +5bp sell stamp +0.1bp transfer each side +5bp slippage each side =21.2bp trade cost; at50% exposure10.6bp NAV. Twice this rounded upward to25bp is a meaningful NAV improvement hurdle, not estimated alpha or actual broker cost.
primary_objective.confidence_rule: One-sided95% lower bound >0.0025 at single final point; all required comparisons/gates must hold
primary_objective.metric: Paired20-session fee-after NAV return improvement over every preregistered comparable baseline

statistics.method: Paired calendar-date moving-block bootstrap, block length20 sessions; same-day securities jointly resampled; seed1701,2000 replicates
statistics.multiple_comparison_policy: Intersection-union: every preregistered required baseline and gate must pass; no choosing favorable comparison. Sensitivity does not create another PASS look.
probability_checks: Brier/log loss against development base rate and transparent rule
fixed5 equal-width reliability bins,20 mature cases per occupied bin
ROC discrimination and selected-subset support, no probability reliability claim from lower Brier alone
statistics.reference: Kunsch(1989), The jackknife and the bootstrap for general stationary observations, Ann.Statist.17:1217–1241; author bibliography https://people.math.ethz.ch/~hkuensch/papers/
statistics.validity: Stationarity/weak-dependence assumptions and finite-sample coverage must be automatically validated and technically reviewed in20.30 blocks is a conservative design eligibility condition, not a universal bootstrap theorem; inadequate support or failed assumptions=>INCONCLUSIVE, never lower cutoff after seeing sealed.
